They dictate 'how' you will get where you want to be, regardless of your current motivation, mood, or willpower. A New Year’s resolution to 'write a novel' is a goal. A system of 'writing 500 words every weekday morning before checking email' is a system. One can be easily derailed by a tough week; the other is almost inevitable because it is built into your daily routine.
